```{r}
install.packages("tximport")

```



```{r}
# Load libraries
library(tximport)
library(readr)
library(DESeq2)

# Load sample metadata
samples <- read_tsv("samples.txt")

# Set up paths and names
files <- samples$quant
names(files) <- samples$sample_id

# Load transcript-to-gene map from Trinity
tx2gene <- read_tsv("Trinity.fasta.gene_trans_map", col_names = c("TXNAME", "GENEID"))

# Import Salmon quantifications
txi <- tximport(files, type = "salmon", tx2gene = tx2gene)

# Create DESeq2 dataset
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromTximport(txi, colData = samples, design = ~ species)

# Run DESeq2
dds <- DESeq(dds)

# Results for syriaca vs speciosa
res <- results(dds, contrast = c("species", "syriaca", "speciosa"))

# View summary
summary(res)

# Order by adjusted p-value
resOrdered <- res[order(res$padj), ]

# Write results
write.csv(as.data.frame(resOrdered), file = "DESeq2_results_sy_vs_sp.csv")

```
